profile.headline: IT Manager, Software Engineer at Macy's
profile.summary:
Over the course of my 15+ years in Information Technology I have been a programmer analyst, senior software developer, project leader\information system officer and a software development manager.  I specialize in building and aligning organizations with strategic IT business objectives to achieve dramatic bottom line-results.  I also have a proven exceptional background in project management, team building and customer relationship management.  I have a real passion for assisting organizations with software solutions to improve their cost savings and revenue.

As a software development manager for 8 years, I have led a team of developers and database developers thru the Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC) of several $MM software projects. Our team was noted for delivering rapid cost effective software solutions to high volume monetary and non monetary transactions that reduced cost, increased revenue and streamlined business processes.  The reason for my success as a manager has been in fostering a team oriented work environment where everyone helped and coached one another and people were acknowledged for their outstanding efforts, both personally and financially.
 
In short, I save time and money by working with organizations to develop software solutions that produce immediate cost savings and increased productivity.  I have a strong technical background with a history of delivering outstanding customer service.  My goal is to continue to leverage my vast years of experience and education in the support of an organizations IT business objectives.

Specialties: -	$MM Project Management                              
-       Application Architecture and Design
-       Full Stack Developer
-	Process Management
-      .Net Technologies
-	(SDLC) Software Development Life Cycle
-       Web Development
-       Database Administration
-	Personnel Recruiting/Management
-       Web services
-	Methodologies: AGILE, SCRUM, RAD   
-	Customer Relationship Management
